description.en:
The IDs of the check items.

>  You can call the [ListCheckResult](~~ListCheckResult~~) operation to query the IDs of the check items.

description.zh: 需要加白的云产品实例ID。多个ID使用英文逗号（,）隔开。
description.en: IDs of the cloud product instances that need to be whitelisted. Separate multiple IDs with a comma (,).
The description. The value of this parameter can be up to 65,535 bytes in length.

description.zh:
规则类型。默认**WHITE**。取值：
- **WHITE**: 加白名单
description.en:
The type of the rule. Default value: **WHITE**. Valid value:

*   **WHITE**: Add check items to the whitelist.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas add-check-result-white-list --check-ids 152 --rule-type WHITE --remark test --instance-ids i-2ze3a5ws0mjvqwqr0000 --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas AddCheckResultWhiteList --region cn-hangzhou --RuleType WHITE --CheckIds.1 152 --InstanceIds.1 'i-2ze3a5ws0mjvqwqr0000' --Remark test
